description: Pair the true one-unit bottom-left horizontal boundary edge with the full two-unit left and right vertical boundary runs. Proposed error treats each colored straight run as one length unit rather than counting the intermediate original dots; the balanced bump/notch cancel around width3 by mistaken height1, yielding3.
